text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Tuesday it lowered its earnings estimates for Chesapeake Energy Corp for the second half of 1997 and for 1998 in light of delays in the timing of three new wells coming on production in Louisiana.
-- Hanifen also cited an infrastructure-constrained drilling schedule for fiscal 1998.
-- Hanifen cut its estimate for the third quarter of 1997 to $0.24 a share from $0.25 and for the fourth quarter to $0.14 from $0.19.
-- The estimate for Chesapeake Energy's 1998 earnings is $1.13 a share from $1.32, Hanifen said.
-- Hanifen said its revised 12-month price target of $30 a share, down from $45, reflects a multiple of seven times Hanifen's calendar year 1998 cash flow estimate of $4.17 per share.
-- Chesapeake Energy is an oil and gas production company whose shares closed up 3/4 Tuesday at 16-1/2.
